description: The bar chart illustrates the average number of likes across different categories, with the x-axis representing the categories labeled as interval ranges (0,90], (90,180], (180,270], (270,360], and (360,450], and the y-axis labeled "Avg. Like #" displaying the average number of likes on a linear scale ranging from 400 to 600 with a tick label interval of 50. The bars are colored light blue and are accompanied by error bars indicating the range of values. The average number of likes for each category is approximately 590 for (0,90], 560 for (90,180], 565 for (180,270], 585 for (270,360], and 580 for (360,450]. The bars are arranged in the order of their corresponding interval ranges on the x-axis, with no apparent sorting by value. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bar, and all bars are presented with the same color and style.
